Args (e.g. verify, scan, token-list, accounts, deploy)

Dastyab is a Rust-based CLI VPN tool. The Rust command engine is bundled inside this Android app and works without a startup download. Linux system services and external engines require separate Android integration.
verify — Verify the active Cloudflare token
accounts — List and manage Cloudflare accounts
profiles — List and manage tunnel profiles
scan — Scan for available tunnel endpoints
deploy — Deploy a new tunnel configuration
autopilot — Run automated setup and deployment
security — Run security checks and audits
configs — List and manage configuration files
backup — Create a backup of dastyab state
routes — List and manage tunnel routes
